purpose: One-factor-at-a-time encoder operating-point pilot under the FROZEN production gate. Measures accepted bytes; changes no threshold.

baselineEvidence.note: Observational only: both runs are logs of the same 226 sources with different learned states; not a controlled A/B.

identity.sourceMatching: jobId (URI hash) and nameHash identify NAMES. Before a pilot run, compute full SHA-256 of each local original with `run_experiment.py hash`; the app's job records carry sourceFingerprint (sampled) from this build. Private paths never enter this file.
identity.learnedState: Record the learned_state_snapshot sha256 at each arm's start. Do not clear app data. Experimental arms learn under their own key suffix (EncoderExperiments.learningKeySuffix), so they neither read nor write the baseline's ratios.

blockedArms.label: encoder_complexity
blockedArms.reason: Media3 1.11 Transformer exposes no KEY_COMPLEXITY request; needs a custom Codec.EncoderFactory. The run_identity encoder inventory will show whether c2.qti.hevc.encoder advertises a complexity range at all.

blockedArms.label: cq_rate_control
blockedArms.reason: CQ needs its own quality search (KEY_QUALITY points) and an empirical size model; not implemented. The encoder inventory will show whether CQ is advertised.

orderNote: Same source order in every arm; baseline repeated last to measure repeatability. Device on charge, comparable starting thermal state, screen recording and Perfetto trace on job_458aa0663c3e in the first A0.
stopping: Extend beyond the pilot only if an arm keeps all regression controls accepted and improves accepted bytes on matched sources. Report the tested frontier if no arm does.
